name: university-attendance-system
description: Multi-tenant university attendance management SaaS with RBAC, fraud detection, audit trails, and premium analytics.

scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npm run prisma:seed
